contract.task_clause:
In selecting an appropriate sample for a substantive test the auditor most likely would stratify the population if the
Option A: Auditor suspects that management fraud has occurred during the year.
Option B: Desired assessed level of control risk is less than the prior year.
Option C: Technique to be used is attribute sampling.
Option D: Auditor plans to give greater representation to large recorded amounts.
